description: This file contains an implementation of the Blake3 hashing algorithm optimized with SSE4.1 instructions, including SIMD vector operations, message scheduling, and compression functions. It provides functions for hashing data blocks in parallel using SIMD registers.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i loadu(const uint8_t src[16])
methods.description: Loads 16 bytes from source into an __m128i register, unaligned.

methods.name: INLINE void storeu(__m128i src,uint8_t dest[16])
methods.description: Stores 16 bytes from an __m128i register into destination memory, unaligned.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i addv(__m128i a,__m128i b)
methods.description: Performs element-wise 32-bit integer addition on two __m128i registers.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i xorv(__m128i a,__m128i b)
methods.description: Performs element-wise XOR operation on two __m128i registers.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i set1(uint32_t x)
methods.description: Creates an __m128i register with all four 32-bit lanes set to the given value.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i set4(uint32_t a,uint32_t b,uint32_t c,uint32_t d)
methods.description: Creates an __m128i register with four specified 32-bit values.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i rot16(__m128i x)
methods.description: Rotates bytes within each 128-bit register by 16 bits using shuffle.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i rot12(__m128i x)
methods.description: Rotates 32-bit integers within register by 12 bits using shift and XOR.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i rot8(__m128i x)
methods.description: Rotates bytes within each 128-bit register by 8 bits using shuffle.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i rot7(__m128i x)
methods.description: Rotates 32-bit integers within register by 7 bits using shift and XOR.

methods.name: INLINE void g1(__m128i * row0,__m128i * row1,__m128i * row2,__m128i * row3,__m128i m)
methods.description: Performs a mixing operation on four __m128i registers with message input.

methods.name: INLINE void g2(__m128i * row0,__m128i * row1,__m128i * row2,__m128i * row3,__m128i m)
methods.description: Performs an alternative mixing operation on four __m128i registers with message input.

methods.name: INLINE void diagonalize(__m128i * row0,__m128i * row2,__m128i * row3)
methods.description: Rearranges lanes across three __m128i registers to facilitate parallel processing.

methods.name: INLINE void undiagonalize(__m128i * row0,__m128i * row2,__m128i * row3)
methods.description: Reverses the diagonalize rearrangement of lanes.

methods.name: INLINE void compress_pre(__m128i rows[4],const uint32_t cv[8],const uint8_t block[BLAKE3_BLOCK_LEN],uint8_t block_len,uint64_t counter,uint8_t flags)
methods.description: Prepares state registers for compression, loading message and running multiple rounds of the permutation.

methods.name: void blake3_compress_in_place_sse41(uint32_t cv[8],const uint8_t block[BLAKE3_BLOCK_LEN],uint8_t block_len,uint64_t counter,uint8_t flags)
methods.description: Compresses a data block in-place, updating the chaining value.

methods.name: void blake3_compress_xof_sse41(const uint32_t cv[8],const uint8_t block[BLAKE3_BLOCK_LEN],uint8_t block_len,uint64_t counter,uint8_t flags,uint8_t out[64])
methods.description: Performs compression on a data block and outputs extended output buffer.

methods.name: INLINE void round_fn(__m128i v[16],__m128i m[16],size_t r)
methods.description: Executes one round of the hash permutation on message and state vectors.

methods.name: INLINE void hash_one_sse41(const uint8_t * input,size_t blocks,const uint32_t key[8],uint64_t counter,uint8_t flags,uint8_t flags_start,uint8_t flags_end,uint8_t out[BLAKE3_OUT_LEN])
methods.description: Hashes a single input buffer, possibly multiple blocks, with a key and counter, producing a hash output.

methods.name: void blake3_hash4_sse41(const uint8_t * const * inputs,size_t blocks,const uint32_t key[8],uint64_t counter,bool increment_counter,uint8_t flags,uint8_t flags_start,uint8_t flags_end,uint8_t * out)
methods.description: Hashes up to four inputs in parallel using SIMD, producing output buffers.

methods.name: INLINE void load_counters(uint64_t counter,bool increment_counter,__m128i * out_lo,__m128i * out_hi)
methods.description: Loads and potentially increments the counter registers for parallel hashing.

methods.name: void blake3_hash_many_sse41(const uint8_t * const * inputs,size_t num_inputs,size_t blocks,const uint32_t key[8],uint64_t counter,bool increment_counter,uint8_t flags,uint8_t flags_start,uint8_t flags_end,uint8_t * out)
methods.description: Hashes multiple inputs in parallel with SIMD, handling multiple blocks and using a counter.
